name: MEVbot_0xdd7c
fix_description: In uniswapV3SwapCallback (0xfa461e33), there is no validation that msg.sender is a legitimate Uniswap V3 pool. Any caller can invoke this callback and trigger token transfers. Add require(msg.sender == computePoolAddress(factory, token0, token1, fee)) to verify the caller.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step drain using an Aave flash loan plus several crafted low-level calls into a vulnerable router and Curve pool swaps to convert/manipulate assets, so it requires understanding protocol-specific router behavior and token flow rather than a trivial bug pattern. While the exploit code is not very long, identifying the callable function selector and sequencing the cross-contract interactions would likely take an experienced auditor more than a quick pass.
